In detail

The Oktogon/Andrássy út end of Budapest's "Bulinegyed" (party district) and one of the districts named in the July 2025 citywide theft-hotspot map alongside V, VII, VIII, IX, X and XV. The scale of the nightlife-related disorder problem led the police to open a dedicated party-district police station in January 2025, specifically to give a faster response to the crowds, theft and disorder concentrated around this area at night. Sources checked: Index.hu, 31 Jan 2025 (dedicated Bulinegyed police station opens); Metropol.hu, 20 Jul 2025 (30-day crime-hotspot map).
